bundle.title: Support bundle
bundle.description: Generate a redacted diagnostics package for McHarbor support.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Run health checks with pass, warning and failure verdicts.

inventory.title: State inventory
inventory.description: What lives in the data directory, its size and whether it is backed up.

database.unreachable: The database does not answer. Check that it is running and that MCHARBOR_DB_DSN or DATABASE_PATH points at it.

migrations.ok: Every migration this version ships has been applied.
migrations.pending: Some migrations have not been applied. Restart McHarbor so it can apply them, and check the log if they keep failing.
migrations.ahead: The database has migrations this version does not know. It was used by a newer McHarbor; do not run an older version against it.
migrations.unreadable: The migration ledger could not be read. Check database connectivity first.

data_dir.ok: The data directory exists, is writable and has room.
data_dir.missing: The data directory does not exist. Check DATA_DIR and the volume mount.
data_dir.not_writable: McHarbor cannot write to the data directory. Check the mount is not read-only and the process owns it.
data_dir.low_space: Less than 2 GB is free. Free space before running backups, exports or an upgrade.

docker.ok: Every directly connected Docker host answered within 5 seconds.
docker.some_unreachable: Some Docker hosts did not answer within 5 seconds. Check the socket mount or TCP address of those environments.
docker.unreachable: No directly connected Docker host answered. Check the Docker socket mount and that the daemon is running.
docker.none: There are no directly connected Docker environments.
docker.unreadable: The environment list could not be read.

agents.ok: Every agent environment has a connected agent.
agents.disconnected: Some agents are not connected to this node. Check the agent service on those hosts and their route to McHarbor.
agents.unreadable: The environment list could not be read.

plugins.load_failed: Some plugins failed to load. A plugin built for another McHarbor build must be updated or repaired from the Plugin Store.
plugins.runtime_off: The plugin runtime is not active on this platform or has not started yet.

identity.local_only: Only local accounts can sign in. Add an identity provider under Security if you use single sign-on.
identity.unreadable: The identity provider list could not be read.

outbound.unreachable: The catalog URL did not answer within 5 seconds. Check DNS, the proxy and the firewall for outbound HTTPS.
outbound.server_error: The catalog URL answered with a server error. The catalog may be down; try again later.
outbound.not_configured: No catalog URL is configured, so outbound access was not tested.

tls.ok: The certificate is valid for more than 30 days.
tls.expiring: The certificate expires within 30 days. Upload a renewed certificate or regenerate the self-signed one.
tls.expired: The certificate has expired. Browsers and agents will refuse it until it is replaced.
tls.unreadable: The certificate file could not be parsed.
tls.disabled: TLS is disabled (TLS_ENABLED=false). Terminate TLS at a reverse proxy.

backup_key.present: A backup encryption key is loaded.
backup_key.missing: No backup encryption key is loaded, so backups cannot be encrypted. Mount one at BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE.

encryption_key.env: The data encryption key comes from ENCRYPTION_KEY.
encryption_key.auto_generated: The data encryption key was generated into DATA_DIR/.encryption_key. Losing that file loses every stored secret, and each HA node would generate its own. Copy it into ENCRYPTION_KEY.

readiness.ok: This node is ready to take traffic.
readiness.not_ready: This node is not ready: see which readiness condition is false.
readiness.not_ready_yet: The cluster service has not started yet.

target_migrations.target_unknown: The target version's migrations cannot be known until its image is pulled. The current database is fully migrated.
target_migrations.pending: This version still has unapplied migrations. Resolve them before upgrading.
target_migrations.ahead: The database already carries migrations this version does not know.
target_migrations.unreadable: The migration ledger could not be read.

plugin_compat.ok: Every installed plugin declares support for the target version.
plugin_compat.incompatible: Some plugins do not declare support for the target version. They will not load until updated.
plugin_compat.unknown: Some plugins declare no readable version range. Check them after the upgrade.
plugin_compat.unreadable: The installed plugin list could not be read.

busy.idle: No backup, export or support bundle is running.
busy.running: A backup, export or support bundle is running. An upgrade restarts McHarbor and would interrupt it.

bundle.previewDescription: This is exactly what the bundle will contain: {{count}} files, {{size}}.
bundle.previewTruncated: Only the first 64 KB are shown; the bundle contains the whole file.
bundle.historyDescription: The newest {{count}} bundles are kept; older ones are deleted automatically.
bundle.empty: No bundles have been generated yet.
bundle.failed: Generation failed. The server log has the details.
bundle.deleteDescription: The bundle file is removed from this server. Copies already downloaded are not affected.

inventory.title: State inventory
inventory.description: Everything McHarbor keeps in its data directory: how large it is, whether McHarbor can write to it, whether an instance backup carries it and whether it can be cleaned up. Read-only.
inventory.truncated: Size is a lower bound; the walk stopped early.

preUpgrade.title: Pre-upgrade check
preUpgrade.description: What to know before upgrading from {{current}} to {{target}}. This check changes nothing and does not block the update.
preUpgrade.rollbackSqlite: Take an instance backup first (Settings → System → Instance backup). SQLite migrations only move forward: to roll back, stop McHarbor, restore the backup or a copy of the data volume, and start the previous image tag.
preUpgrade.rollbackExternal: Take a dump of the external database first. Migrations only move forward: to roll back, stop every node, restore the dump and start the previous image tag on all nodes together.
preUpgrade.rollbackImage: The previous image stays in the local image cache, so it can be started again without a download.
preUpgrade.rollbackKey: Keep ENCRYPTION_KEY, MCHARBOR_SECRET and the backup key unchanged across the upgrade and any rollback.
preUpgrade.compatLink: Compatibility matrix: supported databases, agent version floors, HA modes and tested Docker and Kubernetes versions

keyBanner.title: The data encryption key only exists inside the data directory
keyBanner.description: ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set, so McHarbor generated DATA_DIR/.encryption_key. If that file is lost every stored secret is unreadable, and a second node would generate a different key. Copy the key into ENCRYPTION_KEY.
